# North Station pump inspection, 13 June 2025

Technician Rosa Delgado carried out the summer quarterly round on the two Hydra P-40 pumps at North Station.

Pump HP40-2291 now shows a slow drip from its mechanical seal, and its bearing temperature has risen to 52 °C. Delgado tagged HP40-2291 for a seal change before the end of the month.

Pump HP40-1183, with the seal fitted on 31 March, was dry: no leaks were found on HP40-1183, and its bearing temperature was 49 °C.

Measured flow: HP40-1183 delivered 40 litres per second, HP40-2291 delivered 39 litres per second.
